metadata.name: AccountCreation
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to create a new account under mentioned merchant via any 3rd party or the client itself.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: Product ID of the product for which account is to be created. Valid Values: As provided by CoreCard. Example: 1234

request_fields.name: MerchantID
request_fields.description: Unique number of merchant account. Valid Values: As provided by CoreCard. Example: 35632

request_fields.name: StoreID
request_fields.description: ID of the Store where account is to be created. Valid Values: As provided by CoreCard Example: 13432 Condition: If the program configuration requires a Store during account creation, this tag is mandatory; otherwise, it is optional.

request_fields.name: CreditLimit
request_fields.description: Credit Limit of account. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXX Example: 500.00

request_fields.name: Title
request_fields.description: Title of the Applicant. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Title Values Example:Mr Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: Applicant's First name. Valid Values: A-Z,0-9,and Special Characters Example: John Condition: If PII information is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MiddleName
request_fields.description: Applicant's Middle Name Valid Values: A-Z,0-9,and Special Characters Example: K Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Applicant's last name. Valid Values: A-Z,0-9,and Special Characters Example:LEE Condition: If PII information is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SurnameSuffix
request_fields.description: Applicant's surname-suffix Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Applicant's address line 1. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: 123 HWY Condition: If PII information is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Applicant's address line 2. Valid Values: A-Z,0-9 Example: Park Avenue Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: State
request_fields.description: Applicant's State name. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section State Codes Example: AK Condition: If PII information is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: City
request_fields.description: City name of the applicant's address. Example: Los Angeles Condition: If PII information is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Postal code of the applicant's address. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 46206 Condition: If PII information is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: Country
request_fields.description: Country name of the applicant's address. Valid Values: Refer appendix section Country Code Values Example: US Condition: If PII information is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: EmailID
request_fields.description: Applicant's email id. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format: [email protected] Example: [email protected] Condition: If email is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 256

request_fields.name: LanguageIndicator
request_fields.description: Language indicatior Valid Values: 'en' Example: 'en' Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: HomePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Applicant's Home Phone number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 7895463241 Condition: If Home Phone is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Applicant's Work phone number Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXX Example: 5678909876 Condition: This is mandatory only for selective products as per value of PID. Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: MobilePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Applicant's Mobile Phone Number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 987567757 Condition: If Mobile Phone Number is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: OtherPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Applicant's other Phone Number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 987567757 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateOfBirth
request_fields.description: Applicant's Date of Birth. Format: MM/dd/YYYY Example: 07/25/1991 Condition: If PII information is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory.

request_fields.name: EmployerName
request_fields.description: Applicant's employer name. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Condition: If PII information is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: EmployeeNumber
request_fields.description: Applicant's employer number Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: EmployerPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Applicant's employer Phone number Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 987567757 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: EmployerFaxNumber
request_fields.description: Applicant's employer Fax number. Valid Values: A-Z,0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 34232 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: MotherMaidenName
request_fields.description: Applicant's Mother Maiden Name Valid Values: A-Z Example: Johnson Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SocialSecurityNumber
request_fields.description: Applicant's Social Security Number Format: AAAGGSSSS Example: 078051120 Condition: If PII information is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: IDType
request_fields.description: Type of Government issued identification. Valid Values:Refer Appendix section 5.2 Example: 10 Condition: This field will become mandatory basis following two conditions: 1.For US State Cards This field is mandatory only when ID Type on product is set as Yes for Card Type = Primary. 2.For Non-US State cards This field is mandatory only when ID Type (Non-US) on product is set as Yes for Card Type=Primary. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: IDNumber
request_fields.description: Government issued identification number. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:CDDA97418Q Condition:This field is mandatory when ID Type is having a valid value. Allowable Values: 18

request_fields.name: IDIssueDate
request_fields.description: Issue date of ID card. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 02/01/2020 Condition:This field is mandatory when ID Type is having a valid value.

request_fields.name: IDExpirationDate
request_fields.description: Government issued identification expiration date. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 02/01/2020 Condition: This field is mandatory when ID Type is having a valid value.

request_fields.name: IDIssueCountry
request_fields.description: Government identification issued country. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section Country Code Values Example: US Condition: This field is mandatory when ID Type is having a valid value. Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: IDIssueState
request_fields.description: Government identification issued state. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section State Codes Example: AL Condition: This field is mandatory when ID Type is having a valid value. Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: RegulationOFlag
request_fields.description: Regulation O Flag to classify RegO Account Valid Values: 1 = YES, 0 = NO Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RegulationOFlagEffectiveDate
request_fields.description: Date of effective Reg 'O' Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 02/01/2020 Condition: RegulationOFlagEffectiveDate is mandatory when RegulationOFlag = 1

request_fields.name: BillingTable
request_fields.description: ID of the Billing Table to be assigned on account. Valid Values: As provided by CoreCard Example: 1234 Condition:If no value is provided then default Billing Table(basis criteria defined on Billing Group) will get assigned to Account

request_fields.name: NumberofCardsRequested
request_fields.description: Number of Cards Requested. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX Example: 02

request_fields.name: EmbossingLine4
request_fields.description: Embossing line4 Valid Values: A-Z Example: abc Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: BillingCycle
request_fields.description: Biiling cycle Valid Values: 1-31 Example: 10 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: NameOnCard
request_fields.description: Name to be printed on the card. Name to be embossed on card If there no input for this parameter then API would by default bring First Name +Initial Middle Name+ Last Name Valid Values: A-Z Example: John J Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: TotalAnnualIncome
request_fields.description: Total Annual Income of applicant. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 500.00 Condition: If PII information is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory.

request_fields.name: CurrentEmploymentMonths
request_fields.description: Number of months in current employment. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 10 Condition: If PII information is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Position
request_fields.description: Employement position of the applicant. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: Manager Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: EmploymentType
request_fields.description: Type of employment of applicant Valid Values:Refer Appendix Section - Employment Type Example: 1 Condition: If PII information is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: ResidenceType
request_fields.description: Type of Residince that applicant lives in. Valid Values:Refer Appendix Section - Residence Ownership Code Example: 1 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: MonthsAtResidence
request_fields.description: Duration on residence in months. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 50 Condition: If PII information is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory.

request_fields.name: YearsAtResidence
request_fields.description: Duration on residence in years. Condition: If Years At Residence is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 5 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: CompanyName
request_fields.description: Company Name Valid Values: A-Z Example: abc Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 26

request_fields.name: CompanyNumber
request_fields.description: Company Number Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1234 Allowable Values: 7

request_fields.name: CompanyPrimaryContact
request_fields.description: Company Primary Contact number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 4785885585 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: CompanyPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Company's Phone number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 7895463214 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: CompanyFaxNumber
request_fields.description: Company's Fax number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 7895463214 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: CorporateAccountNumber
request_fields.description: Corporate Account Number. Condition: If Corporate Account Number is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 10585858444 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: QRCode
request_fields.description: QRCode Condition: If QR Code is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CashCreditLimit
request_fields.description: Cash Credit Limit of account. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 500.00

request_fields.name: ShippingAddressFlag
request_fields.description: This flag decides if we want to ship the new card to existing address or alternate address. Valid Values: 0 = Ship to Existing Address 1 = Ship Address Example: 0 Condition: Default value would be 0. Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: ShippingAddressLine1
request_fields.description: Shipping address line 1. Valid Values : A-Z, 0-1 Example: 2354 Main road Condition: If ShippingAddressFlag is 1 then it is mandatory Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShippingAddressLine2
request_fields.description: Shipping address line 2. Valid Values : A-Z, 0-1 Example: xyz Avenue Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShippingCity
request_fields.description: Shipping address city name. Valid Values : A-Z Example: chicago Condition: If ShippingAddressFlag is 1 then it is mandatory. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: ShippingState
request_fields.description: State of the shipping address. Valid Values : Refer Appendix Section State Codes Condition: If ShippingAddressFlag is 1 then it is mandatory. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: ShippingCountry
request_fields.description: Shipping address Country name. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section Country Code Values Condition: If ShippingAddressFlag is 1 then it is mandatory Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: ShippingPostalCode
request_fields.description: Zip code of the shipping address. Valid Values : 0-9 Example: 48521 Condition: If ShippingAddressFlag is 1 then it is mandatory. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: HoldEmbossing
request_fields.description: Hold Embossing. Valid Values: 1= YES, 0 = NO Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: StatementProduction
request_fields.description: Statement production to be process normally, online only or hold statement. Condition: If Statement production is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Valid Values: 0 = Process normally, 1 = Online only, 2 = Hold statement Example: 0 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: IsMLAAccount
request_fields.description: Identify whether the account is MLA type or not. Valid Values: Yes-1, No-0 Example: 0 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: CardImageID
request_fields.description: Art/Template ID based on this Card’s Image will be displayed. Valid Values: 0-9, a-z Example: 30abc Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: SignatureID
request_fields.description: This tag is to capture the user signature image file URL. Valid Values: 0-9,A-Z Condition: If Signature ID is set as mandatory on product, then this tag is mandatory. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ActivationCode
request_fields.description: Security Code provided at the time of Account Creation/Registration. Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: NameOnTrack
request_fields.description: Name to be printed on the card. Valid Values: A-z Example: John J Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 26

request_fields.name: PromoPurchaseAllow
request_fields.description: Weather to allow Promo Purchase on account or not. Valid Values: 0=No, 1=Yes Example: 0

request_fields.name: CoApplicantFlag
request_fields.description: Co-Applicant is required or not. Valid Values: 0-No,1-Yes Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: CoApplicantFirstName
request_fields.description: Co-Applicant’s First Name. Valid Values: A-Z,0-9 Example: John Condition: If Co-Applicant Flag = 1 then mandatory. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CoApplicantMiddleName

request_fields.name: CoApplicantCombinedTotalIncome
request_fields.description: Co-Applicant’s Combined Total Income. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 500.00 Condition: If Co-Applicant Flag = 1 then mandatory.

request_fields.name: CoApplicantWorkPhoneNumber

request_fields.description: To decide if Duplicate Check should honor while Account Creation or not. Valid Values: 1- Duplicate Check 0- By-Pass Duplicate Check Example: 0 Condition: If no value pass in this field then default should be consider as 1-Duplicate Check.

request_fields.name: IsApplicantMLA
request_fields.description: Flag to identify Applicant as MLA Valid Values: 0-No,1-Yes Format: xx Example: 0/1 Condition: If the Tag IsMLAAccount (Existing Tag) is marked as Yes then either IsApplicantMLA or IsCosignerMLA or Both tag must be marked as Yes.

request_fields.name: DefaultBillingCycleOnNoActivity
request_fields.description: Assigns the billing-cycle date when no activity occurs within the 'Days Until Billing Cycle Default' period. If activity occurs earlier, this date still applies. When set, it overrides the product’s 'Minimum Days to Billing Cycle After Base Date' rule. Valid Values: 1-31 Example: 20 Condition: Mandatory when a value is provided for the ‘Days Until Billing Cycle Default’ tag.
